Title: Istorica descrizione de' tre' regni Congo, Matamba, et Angola situati nell'Etiopia inferiore occidentale e delle missioni apostoliche esercitatevi da religiosi Capuccini
Creator: Giovanni Antonio Cavazzi da Montecuccolo, Capuchin, former prefect of the mission; compiled and arranged by Fortunato Alamandini da Bologna
Publisher: Bologna: per Giacomo Monti, 1687
Publication Date: 1687
Rights: Public Domain (published 1687, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item carries no rights field, so the date rule alone applies)
Language: ita
Source: Internet Archive item istoricadescrizi00cava (https://archive.org/details/istoricadescrizi00cava), the item's own istoricadescrizi00cava_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: Getty Research Institute; host metadata date: 1687. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 9fd49577988706fcd78b6eba79bd31aa1ae8d56ef2455a77ca03e498e4ff305b.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. Getty Research Institute scan; usable OCR with the long s read as f and the printed marginal summaries interleaved into the text in short broken lines. Folio of seven books with engraved plates.
Content note: The Capuchin mission's own history of Kongo, Matamba and Angola from the arrival of the Capuchins in 1645 to the 1660s, by a missionary who served there, as put in order by Alamandini: the land, the peoples and their religion as the friars saw it, the kings, the queen Njinga, and the friars' work of baptism and the burning of shrines.
